title: Sectionwise quasi-isomorphisms are quasi-isomorphisms of sheaves
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, $R$ a sheaf of rings on it, and $f:K^\bullet\to L^\bullet$ a map of cochain complexes of $R$-module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. If $\Gamma(U,f)$ is a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] of complexes of abelian groups for every object $U$ of $\mathcal C$, then $f$ is a quasi-isomorphism of module-sheaf complexes.

proof.text: Forget the module structures and view the complexes as complexes of presheaves of abelian groups. Mathlib HomologicalComplex.quasiIso_iff_evaluation makes the sectionwise hypothesis a quasi-isomorphism of those presheaf complexes. The mapHomologicalComplexCompIso identifies evaluation of a mapped complex with mapping by the section functor.

Exact abelian sheafification preserves this quasi-isomorphism. Its natural counit is an isomorphism on sheaves, so NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex and Arrow.isoOfNatIso identify the sheafified presheaf map with the original map of abelian-sheaf complexes.

The exact module-to-abelian-sheaf forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms. Apply Mathlib HomologicalComplex.quasiIso_map_iff_of_preservesHomology to conclude that the original module-sheaf map is a quasi-isomorphism. The complete Lean proof uses the source library exactness instances for SheafOfModules.toSheaf.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 0A95, with the degreewise and exact-sheafification argument spelled out
